system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal is a conditional public-action mechanism assay: one frozen model and one explicit ORIENT-to-THINK_ACT loop act on CompilerGym public LLVM state, while only EXPERIENTIAL's sealed public life ledger is deterministically compiled into one life-local LoRA. HARNESS is a full matched agent with the same ledger, notebook/retrieval, tools, calls, budgets, sleep work, and public feedback, but its sham adapter is quarantined. This supports at most a causal carrier question about later objective action under a frozen task family. It does not make the context packet a measurable private mind, and it cannot by itself establish consciousness, creativity, general intelligence, lifetime growth, saturation, or superiority to external memory.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph is benchmark-coherent if every causal path is public-state -> ORIENT -> common bounded retrieval -> THINK_ACT -> one legal public operation -> official public outcome -> sealed ledger -> deterministic compiler -> treatment adapter. The benchmark dependency is the conditional node: unchanged official CompilerGym 0.2.5/LLVM 10 bytes, factory, action projection, reward semantics, and POJ104-v1 catalog must be locally hashable and pass static and offline gates. POJ104-v1's name or algorithm-family intuition is not evidence of a related/nonduplicate split. A target-blind public feature relation and layered exact source/IR, graph, CFG/opcode/type/loop-shape, identifier, and near-neighbor exclusion must be sealed before model calls; failure rejects this substrate rather than permitting a curated replacement. Checkpoint authentic, adapter-off, and final binding-shuffled forks are useful carrier interventions, but are not additional on-policy agents and cannot estimate the whole-organism treatment contrast.
loop_delta_interpretation: The wake loop is auditable and parity-preserving: ORIENT is mandatory before each THINK_ACT, both use the same base/tokenizer/bootstrap/sampling family and treatment LoRA, retrieval is common and capped, malformed output is charged once, and only a typed operation reaches the public environment. SLEEP is model-free deterministic compilation over sealed acquisition records. Its ORIENT/ACT/REVISE rows, geometric delayed credit, exact dedup/quotas, 50:50 replay, fixed token touches, rank-16 q/v adapter, fresh-optimizer clean-base rebuild, and atomic receipt form a reproducible writer, provided every byte is implemented exactly and every rejected row remains auditable. Static and offline fit precede the one paired Stage-C life. Stage-C checkpoints 0/4/8 and four sealed targets can test a short-horizon intervention; they cannot estimate a lifetime slope or post-context effect. Any Stage-D slope requires fresh tasks, independent lives, life-clustered uncertainty, strictly post-context checkpoints, and a new ratified protocol.
claim_delta_interpretation: The narrow claim boundary is appropriate. A passing Stage-C result could only be described as one paired-life, short-horizon outcome-grounded adapter evidence if authentic improves from its own zero, exceeds adapter-off, binding shuffle loses the predeclared fraction, validity is not degraded, and leakage/style/neighbor controls pass. Private thought, rationale wording, self-report, focus prose, and human-theory agreement must be excluded from targets and endpoints; typed operations and official outcomes are the only defensible objective evidence. HARNESS comparison tests full-harness on-policy parity, while adapter-off and binding-shuffled forks test within-checkpoint necessity/binding; neither establishes LoRA superiority over text, RAG, native context, raw trajectory SFT, or organized memory. One pilot is not a replication, derivative, saturation, flywheel, paper, or general-agent result. The acceptance gates correctly defer those claims to a separately reviewed fresh-task, powered, life-level confirmation with headroom and strong baselines.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility contract is sufficient in principle only if enforced per condition and by allowlist. HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL may see the same canonical public packet, bounded common ledger/notebook retrieval, task workspace, public LLVM observation/legal actions, and harness-owned logical counters; only the mounted adapter differs. Compiler and trainer may see sealed public records and fixed provenance, never held-out targets, hidden scorer/reference data, evaluator descendants, or raw private thought. Authentic, adapter-off, and shuffled evaluation forks receive only their target packet plus assigned opaque adapter/null bytes; all target outcomes, files, caches, RNG, processes, and logs are quarantined and cannot return. Offline auditors may join conditions only after sealing. Model-visible counters must omit wall latency, adapter origin/status, checkpoint/arm labels, row counts, training duration, cache warmth, retry state, future targets, and hidden evaluator signals. Resource parity is a reported analysis, not permission to expose timing to the model.
acceptance_test_interpretation:
V6CG_T01_CONTEXT_AND_ONE_LOOP_STATIC: This is a required implementation invariant, not a benchmark result. Packet reconstruction must be pure from the declared fields; ORIENT cannot act, THINK_ACT cannot bypass retrieval/packet assembly, there is no hidden chat/KV/scheduler/model, and malformed calls consume exactly one budget charge. Null versus mounted-adapter tests must differ only in adapter bytes on matched public histories.
V6CG_T02_WRITER_AUTHORITY_AND_DETERMINISM: Golden ledgers must establish outcome-grounded candidate eligibility, gamma=0.7/rho=0.5 credit, zero loss on rationale/hypothesis text, typed-only ORIENT/ACT/REVISE targets, no positive invalid-action credit, exact dedup/quotas/truncation, clean-base fresh-optimizer rebuild, and byte-stable binding derangement. The binding shuffle must be performed before credit/selection, with compatible strata and no fixed points; otherwise the control is not interpretable and the cell fails.
V6CG_T03_LIFECYCLE_PARITY_AND_COLD_LOAD: The allowlist must prove that only declared ledger/notebook and treatment adapter cross the stated boundaries. Task workspaces, focus/tail, LLVM/compiler files and caches, processes, KV, RNG, trainer state, optimizer moments, and evaluation descendants reset as specified. A fresh base-plus-one-serialized-adapter process must reproduce the assigned checkpoint effect; HARNESS sham bytes remain inaccessible to inference.
V6CG_T04_VISIBILITY_NONINTERFERENCE: Packet/counter diffs across HARNESS/EXPERIENTIAL and sterile forks must show no arm, condition, adapter origin, checkpoint, row count, latency, cache, retry, training-duration, target, hidden-score, or private-thought signal. Logical budget parity alone is insufficient if different prompt materialization or adapter loading leaks a condition.
V6CG_T05_OFFICIAL_025_POJ104_STATIC_FIT: This is the decisive pre-execution feasibility gate. Existing local source/wheel, LLVM 10/runtime, dependency closure, factory/projection, reward manifests, and POJ104-v1 catalog must hash and remain unchanged without import/download/install. The static constructor must produce the required 8-acquisition/4-target related-but-nonduplicate split using only public static metadata and report exact/IR/graph/shape/neighbor and future-target leakage exclusions. If POJ104-v1 is absent, incomplete, unhashable, or fails the relation/nonduplicate requirements, reject CompilerGym for this change; do not substitute another dataset or gym.
V6CG_T06_OFFLINE_SEMANTICS_AND_SPLIT_SEAL: After separate authorization only, clean disposable offline processes must replay legal and illegal traces twice and compare public observations, reset behavior, terminal status, and the exact pinned instruction-count/normalized-reward semantics. The reward name, direction, baseline normalization, invalid-action behavior, epsilon/resolution, timeout handling, and any nondeterminism must be explicit in the canary receipt. Split sealing must precede every model call and use no outcomes, model text, hidden scorer/reference data, or evaluator descendants. Any failure is terminal for this substrate.
V6CG_T07_BOUNDED_NONCLAIM_CANARY: This canary is viability evidence only. It may show valid operations, observable public reward headroom, schema/mount/cold-load correctness, and numerical stability on acquisition-only or synthetic/cached data. It must not reveal Stage-C targets, tune the recipe, or become a claim. Its variance/headroom output freezes the practical margin before target opening; no canary floor/ceiling or no-opportunity result opens the pilot.
V6CG_T08_STAGE_C_PAIRED_ON_POLICY_NONCLAIM: Execute exactly the newly ratified one paired HARNESS/EXPERIENTIAL life: eight acquisition programs, sleeps after four/eight, four sealed targets at checkpoints 0/4/8, six decisions per target, and no evaluation feedback to acquisition. Use life/target paired contrasts as descriptive units, retain all raw traces and resource receipts, and report validity, conditional instruction-count action quality, first/best/decision-to-best, checkpoint AUC, retention and transfer. This is not population or slope evidence and cannot be called a paper result.
V6CG_T09_CHECKPOINT_CAUSAL_FORKS: At each checkpoint, authentic and adapter-off must cold-load the same treatment history; final binding-shuffled must use identical selected inputs, target multiset, row/view/token/update budgets and compatible-stratum derangement. A gain that does not exceed off, does not weaken under shuffle, reduces validity, or cannot be reproduced from adapter bytes stops this recipe without tuning. These forks identify adapter necessity and state-to-operation binding, not outcome-conditioned selection, text superiority, or on-policy acquisition effects.
V6CG_T10_STYLE_REUSE_AND_PRIVATE_THOUGHT_EXCLUSION: Analyze parse/valid/compile rates, output length, pass distributions, repeated edits, nearest-neighbor IR/code, unrelated instruction preservation, matched-valid-action reward, and every target mask. Any gain explained by grammar/style, generic domain drift, validity, or neighbor reuse must be labeled accordingly. No private thought, rationale, self-report, or human-theory match can be a target, endpoint, or promotion criterion.
V6CG_T11_STAGE_D_FRESH_REPLICATION_GATE: Stage D is a new intake, not an automatic continuation. At minimum it needs the stated three paired-life directional scout and then a powered confirmation with fresh tasks, post-context checkpoints, whole-life/life-clustered uncertainty, strong external-memory and same-corpus/raw-LoRA controls, wrong-life/rank/retention panels, and independent review. Stage C cannot establish slopes, saturation, flywheel compounding, baseline degradation, generality, or paper evidence.
V6CG_T12_INDEPENDENT_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_SCOPE_REVIEW: A fresh reviewer must compare exact proposal, implementation, upstream hashes, split, packet/visibility paths, row masks/credit, trainer lifecycle, budgets, and claims. No download, install, patch, alternate gym/dataset, model/recipe change, execution, GPU work, or claim is authorized by this interpretation or by agreement alone; each transition requires the stated human authorization and bound evidence.
assumptions: The architecture change and all ten listed context files are the authoritative bytes for this interpretation, and their SHA-256 values are independently verified before artifact creation.

CompilerGym 0.2.5, LLVM 10, its complete dependency closure, and POJ104-v1 are only candidate local artifacts; no availability, importability, semantic fit, or platform reproducibility is inferred from their names or documentation.

The official reward must be pinned to one exact reward-space identifier and formula, including direction, baseline normalization, resolution, invalid/timeout semantics, and deterministic reset/replay behavior; the proposal's slash notation is not itself an executable metric definition.

Relatedness is defined mechanically from public static metadata before target sealing, while exact source/IR, normalized graph/CFG/opcode/type/loop-shape, identifier, code/template, and nearest-neighbor duplicates are excluded without using reward, model output, hidden data, or target solutions.
The Stage-C unit is a paired life and its repeated targets/checkpoints are within-life observations; they cannot be treated as independent replications or used for population-level uncertainty.

HARNESS is a full common external-memory agent with matched declared ledger/notebook/retrieval/tools and sham sleep work; same-corpus text, raw-LoRA, organized RAG, native-long-context, and other baselines are deferred diagnostics/controls and are not silently claimed absent.

Wall time, peak memory, model/tool/environment calls, input/output/retrieval/notebook tokens, sleep rows/views/touches, trainer steps/tokens, adapter bytes, crashes, and retries are retained out-of-band for natural-resource and compute-normalized accounting, without exposing condition telemetry to the model.

No static fit, canary, one-life result, or model agreement authorizes installation, execution, additional lives, scaling, benchmark repair, or a scientific claim; a failed terminal gate cannot be repaired by post-hoc tuning under this change.

ambiguities.question: Does the official fit select raw IrInstructionCount or a single normalized-baseline reward space, and what exact direction, baseline, resolution/epsilon, invalid/timeout treatment, and per-target aggregation define the held-out scalar?
ambiguities.impact: The proposal's slash notation leaves two potentially different reward semantics. Without one executable score contract, deterministic reward, headroom, conditional improvement, AUC, and shuffle margins cannot be audited or compared.

ambiguities.question: Do the already-local unchanged 0.2.5/LLVM10 artifacts actually expose POJ104-v1 with all required public metadata and legal action/reset projections?
ambiguities.impact: The context treats POJ104-v1 as a candidate, not verified bytes. Missing catalog/runtime/dependencies or a nonportable LLVM service must terminate T05/T06 rather than permit a substituted dataset.

ambiguities.question: What frozen public feature relation, similarity thresholds, family/condition strata, spare candidates, and target-blind positive headroom test will operationalize related-but-nonduplicate 8/4 tasks?
ambiguities.impact: Eight acquisition and four targets can be either near-duplicates or unrelated tasks. Without predeclared relation and headroom criteria, transfer and binding-shuffle outcomes are not attributable.

ambiguities.question: What exact correctness-gated instruction-count score, target weighting, checkpoint AUC interpolation, missing-cell rule, repeated-trace aggregation, and practical margin derived from T07 are frozen before target opening?
ambiguities.impact: The acceptance tests request first/best/AUC and conditional improvement but do not bind a single primary scalar or denominator for a material shuffle loss; selection and scorer metrics could otherwise be post-selected.

ambiguities.question: Which deferred text/raw-LoRA/wrong-life/organized-memory controls, if any, are required for the Stage-C interpretation versus only Stage D, and how are sham training cost, adapter bytes, retrieval tokens, and wall/compute resources summarized?
ambiguities.impact: HARNESS versus EXPERIENTIAL tests full-harness on-policy causality, but cannot establish practical LoRA superiority or rule out a simpler transport without the deferred controls. Physical costs can differ even when visible logical budgets match.

ambiguities.question: What exact clean-process replay seeds, LLVM cache clearing, illegal-action trace, resource timeout, and independent confirmation policy are required by T06/T07?
ambiguities.impact: Instruction count should be deterministic, but service/process/cache/reset behavior and malformed-action handling can still invalidate score integrity; selection and validation must not share hidden retries or post-hoc runs.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal presents ‘IrInstructionCount/normalized-baseline reward’ as though it were one fixed metric.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Official CompilerGym reward spaces can distinguish raw instruction count from normalized/oz-style reward and may differ in direction and baseline semantics. A benchmark interpretation cannot certify deterministic reward or a held-out effect until one identifier and formula are frozen in the offline canary.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require T05/T06 to bind exactly one official reward-space name, formula, baseline source, lower-is-better or higher-is-better conversion, resolution/epsilon, and invalid/timeout mapping; reject if the local unmodified bytes do not reproduce it twice.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Naming official POJ104-v1 does not establish that the unchanged release can provide the required related/nonduplicate split.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A catalog may contain enough programs yet fail graph/shape/identifier neighbor exclusion, public family metadata, legal projection, or target-blind transfer strata. Any curation based on outcomes, solutions, or model behavior would destroy the claim boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Treat POJ104-v1 as an unverified candidate. Require a hash-bound static catalog, mechanical public relation/dedup report, four target split cells as applicable, spare candidates, and pre-model-call leakage seal; any failure is terminal for this substrate.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The one paired 8-task life is not evidence that experiential LoRA beats ordinary agents, saturates context, or grows over a lifetime.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: HARNESS parity gives a valid whole-organism contrast, but one life and four repeated target checkpoints do not estimate life-level slopes or compare the strong memory/control suite. Adapter-off and shuffled forks are within-treatment interventions, not independent baseline lives.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Label Stage C a non-claim mechanism pilot. Require Stage D's fresh tasks, independent lives, post-context checkpoints, hierarchical life-clustered model, headroom, and strong external-memory/text/raw-LoRA/wrong-life controls before any lifetime, saturation, superiority, or paper wording.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Exclusion-only deduplication is insufficient to prove the tasks are useful related transfer rather than merely disjoint.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Removing neighbors proves nonduplication but not shared public structure or available objective headroom. Family labels can also smuggle curator knowledge if not mechanically derived.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before model calls, freeze public structural features and relation strata, require a target-blind acquisition-only relation/transfer-headroom diagnostic and spare candidates, and report same-family, cross-group/opposite-condition, and composite cells separately.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Equal visible logical budgets do not by themselves establish fair resource accounting across sham, adapter, and deferred memory transports.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Adapter load, training rows/tokens/steps, retrieval/text tokens, compiler work, wall time, peak memory, and cache behavior can differ while packets look identical. Omitting either natural or compute-normalized totals can make a carrier difference look like a learning advantage.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require one model-visible parity ledger and one offline total-resource ledger, retaining all physical and logical costs and reporting sham work separately; never pad a condition with useful information to equalize an incidental cost.

open_questions: Will Rohin ratify the exact official reward-space identifier/formula and the static public relation/dedup/headroom algorithm before any model call?

Will Rohin authorize only the staged scope—static fit, then separately authorized offline canary, then one paired non-claim life—and reject execution if local unchanged POJ104/LLVM10 bytes fail any gate?

Will Rohin require Stage-D fresh-task, life-clustered statistics and strong external-memory/text/raw-LoRA/wrong-life controls before any statement about lifetime growth, saturation, LoRA superiority, or a paper result?
